consequence.statement: The istio-base chart now templates the Istio CRDs, so `helm upgrade istio-base` upgrades them, and the CRD labels change to be consistent with other Helm-installed resources. Existing `kubectl apply` installs and upgrades can continue.
consequence.remediation: Check whether you want to manage the Istio CRDs with `helm upgrade istio-base` from now on. If you do, review the CRD label change. If not, keep using `kubectl apply -f manifests/charts/base/files/crd-all.gen.yaml`.

original.statement: In 1.24.0 the istio-base Helm chart templates the Istio CRDs by default, so `helm upgrade istio-base` now upgrades them and their labels change to match other Helm-installed resources; installing or upgrading them with `kubectl apply` still works.

decision.reason: [ev-85eccdc718e3] and [ev-2941a875a468] say the istio-base chart now templates the CRDs, so `helm upgrade istio-base` can upgrade them, and that the CRD labels change to match other Helm-installed resources. Both also say operators who installed or upgraded CRDs with `kubectl apply` can keep doing so. [ev-fa194382072a] adds that templating is now on by default and that `base.enableCRDTemplates=false` brings back the old behaviour. None of this says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so the right consequence is a low-severity behavior-change that needs review, not mandatory work.
